name: io.github.daochild/aifinpay
title: AiFinPay
description: Payment infrastructure for AI agents: wallet, passport, owner-enabled Polygon and Base payments.

environmentVariables.name: SEED_HASH
environmentVariables.description: 32-byte hex seed (64 hex characters), the highest-priority wallet source. Solana, EVM and Casper addresses derive from it.

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_AGENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Legacy base58 Ed25519 secret for a persistent agent identity; Solana, EVM and Casper addresses derive from it. Without any wallet source the server uses an unfunded ephemeral identity.

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_WALLET_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for an encrypted ~/.aifinpay/agent.json keystore created by `npx @aifinpay/mcp init`.

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_PAYMENTS_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Payments (payable_fetch, AIFP-1 v1.4 on Polygon or Base) are on unless this is 0. Only a persistent wallet signs, within the built-in ceiling of $5 per payment and $20 per 24 hours; an unfunded wallet spends nothing.

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Lowers the built-in $5 per-payment ceiling of payable_fetch (default 5; a higher value is refused). The working limits are the dashboard Controls. A tool argument can lower it for one call, never raise it.

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_DAILY_USD
environmentVariables.description: Lowers the built-in $20 rolling 24-hour ceiling (default 20; a higher value is refused).

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_GATEWAY_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Optional allowlist: comma-separated exact HTTPS origins the agent may pay. Unset, any https site; who is paid is decided by the AiFinPay-signed quote, never by the 402.

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_MAX_GAS
environmentVariables.description: Gas cap per payment in the chain's native currency (POL or ETH). Required with payments unless AIFINPAY_MAX_GAS_POL is set on Polygon.

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTPS RPC for the payment chain.

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_MAX_GAS_POL
environmentVariables.description: Gas cap per payment in POL, e.g. 0.3. Polygon only; on Base use AIFINPAY_MAX_GAS.

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the AiFinPay backend. Unset, read-only tools use https://aifinpay.io and payable_fetch quotes and receipts use https://api.aifinpay.io.
